short_description: An evening exploring the mystic arts of devotional dance, poetry, prayer, and live Sufi music. Through whirling, chanting, movement, and sacred practices, this gathering invites deep connection, remembrance, and ecstatic expression in a space for the modern mystic.
description:
Join us for an evening exploring the mystic arts of devotional dance,  poetry and prayers supported by live sufi music.  


A gathering for the modern mystic to connect within, without and with others through sacred Sufi practices. 


🌹 Listen to the whispers of the divine through Whirling, chanting, dancing and praying. 


Be held in an evening of remembrance, guidance through sufi whirling and chanting with Serafina Mystix, ecstatic sufi trance dance with Taban and live music by Meir Gassenbaur & Tal Alkalay.


Turn towards the heart, in sync with the cosmos, letting go of distractions and worldly attachments. Each rotation becoming a silent prayer, a movement towards inner stillness despite external motion. 


Through repetition and rhythm, be moved into trance-like states that elevate consciousness. 


In this spiritual ecstasy, the ego dissolves, and only the presence of the divine remains. 


The whirler becomes a vessel — empty of self, full of spirit.


Saturday 6 June  
6-11pm  
Essencia, Aljezur
